svg.aria-label: A content delivery network: Bob's request is answered by a nearby edge cache, which falls back to a shield cache and then the origin
svg.text: x-cache: MISS, HIT, HIT x-cache-hits: 0, 273, 18 age: 1704

ol.li: The website’s DNS name is a CNAME (Chapter 29) pointing into the content delivery network’s own names, which answer with addresses of a CDN site near the person asking.
Bob’s request reaches an edge cache near him. If it has a fresh copy (Chapter 30’s rules), it answers at once: here, a HIT, and the real server never hears about it.

If not, the edge asks a bigger shield cache near the real server, and only if that misses too does anyone bother the origin. The headers are a record of the journey: this copy was fetched from python.org 1,704 seconds ago (a MISS), and has since been served from the Ashburn cache 273 times.

figure.figcaption: A real content delivery network: curl -sI https://www.python.org/ from Grandpa’s Pi. (Fastly’s names contain city codes; the one near the Pi is blanked out as XXX.)
